pmr_dam_columbia_river_survey_decision = {
	is_shown = {
		has_technology_researched = arc_welding
		NOT = { OR = {
				ROOT ?= { has_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_surveyed }
				AND = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_family  ROOT ?= { OR = { this = global_var:pmr_dam_columbia_river_family  top_overlord ?= { this = global_var:pmr_dam_columbia_river_family } } } }
			} }
		NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_months }
		NOT = { p:x3F0EE7.state ?= { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_large_dear  level_after_queued_constructions >= 9 } } }
		p:x3F0EE7 ?= {
			state ?= {
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						this = ROOT
						any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
						any_scope_treaty = { binds = ROOT  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = ROOT } }
						any_overlord_or_above = { any_scope_treaty = { binds = ROOT  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = ROOT } } }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_bur_tt_1500
			pmr_dam_bur_headroom > 1500
		}
		hidden_trigger = {
			OR = { is_player = yes  NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_took_survey } }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_columbia_river_block_tt
			NOT = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_block }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_columbia_river_queued_tt
			NOT = { p:x3F0EE7.state ?= { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_large_dear
				OR = { AND = { level < 1  level_after_queued_constructions >= 1 }
				AND = { level < 2  level_after_queued_constructions >= 2 }
				AND = { level < 3  level_after_queued_constructions >= 3 }
				AND = { level < 4  level_after_queued_constructions >= 4 }
				AND = { level < 5  level_after_queued_constructions >= 5 }
				AND = { level < 6  level_after_queued_constructions >= 6 }
				AND = { level < 7  level_after_queued_constructions >= 7 }
				AND = { level < 8  level_after_queued_constructions >= 8 }
				AND = { level < 9  level_after_queued_constructions >= 9 }
			} } } }
		}
	}

	when_taken = {
		pmr_dam_columbia_river_begin_survey = yes
		set_variable = { name = pmr_dam_took_survey  days = 30 }
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { pmr_dam_bur_headroom > 1500 }
			add = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { is_at_war = yes  is_diplomatic_play_committed_participant = yes  in_default = yes } }
			multiply = 0
		}
	}
}

			OR = { is_player = yes  NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_took_survey } }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_western_fjords_block_tt
			NOT = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_western_fjords_block }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_western_fjords_queued_tt
			NOT = { p:xA68FB9.state ?= { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_large_cheap
				OR = { AND = { level < 1  level_after_queued_constructions >= 1 }
				AND = { level < 2  level_after_queued_constructions >= 2 }
				AND = { level < 3  level_after_queued_constructions >= 3 }
			} } } }
		}
	}

	when_taken = {
		pmr_dam_western_fjords_begin_survey = yes
		set_variable = { name = pmr_dam_took_survey  days = 30 }
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { pmr_dam_bur_headroom > 950 }
			add = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { is_at_war = yes  is_diplomatic_play_committed_participant = yes  in_default = yes } }
			multiply = 0
		}
	}
}

				AND = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_valais_alps_family  ROOT ?= { OR = { this = global_var:pmr_dam_valais_alps_family  top_overlord ?= { this = global_var:pmr_dam_valais_alps_family } } } }
			} }
		NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_valais_alps_months }
		NOT = { p:x9041E0.state ?= { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_large_cheap  level_after_queued_constructions >= 2 } } }
		p:x9041E0 ?= {
			state ?= {
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						this = ROOT
						any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
						any_scope_treaty = { binds = ROOT  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = ROOT } }
						any_overlord_or_above = { any_scope_treaty = { binds = ROOT  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = ROOT } } }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_bur_tt_850
			pmr_dam_bur_headroom > 850
		}
		hidden_trigger = {
			OR = { is_player = yes  NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_took_survey } }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_valais_alps_block_tt
			NOT = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_valais_alps_block }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_valais_alps_queued_tt
			NOT = { p:x9041E0.state ?= { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_large_cheap
				OR = { AND = { level < 1  level_after_queued_constructions >= 1 }
				AND = { level < 2  level_after_queued_constructions >= 2 }
			} } } }
		}
	}

	when_taken = {
		pmr_dam_valais_alps_begin_survey = yes
		set_variable = { name = pmr_dam_took_survey  days = 30 }
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { pmr_dam_bur_headroom > 850 }
			add = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { is_at_war = yes  is_diplomatic_play_committed_participant = yes  in_default = yes } }
			multiply = 0
		}
	}
}

pmr_dam_kiso_tenryu_survey_decision = {
	is_shown = {
		has_technology_researched = steam_turbine
		NOT = { OR = {
				ROOT ?= { has_variable = pmr_dam_kiso_tenryu_surveyed }
				AND = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_kiso_tenryu_family  ROOT ?= { OR = { this = global_var:pmr_dam_kiso_tenryu_family  top_overlord ?= { this = global_var:pmr_dam_kiso_tenryu_family } } } }
			} }
		NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_kiso_tenryu_months }
		NOT = { p:x3050C0.state ?= { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_large_cheap  level_after_queued_constructions >= 1 } } }
		p:x3050C0 ?= {
			state ?= {
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						this = ROOT
						any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
						any_scope_treaty = { binds = ROOT  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = ROOT } }
						any_overlord_or_above = { any_scope_treaty = { binds = ROOT  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = ROOT } } }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_bur_tt_700
			pmr_dam_bur_headroom > 700
		}
		hidden_trigger = {
			OR = { is_player = yes  NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_took_survey } }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_kiso_tenryu_block_tt
			NOT = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_kiso_tenryu_block }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_kiso_tenryu_queued_tt
			NOT = { p:x3050C0.state ?= { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_large_cheap
				OR = { AND = { level < 1  level_after_queued_constructions >= 1 }
			} } } }
		}
	}

	when_taken = {
		pmr_dam_kiso_tenryu_begin_survey = yes
		set_variable = { name = pmr_dam_took_survey  days = 30 }
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { pmr_dam_bur_headroom > 700 }
			add = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { is_at_war = yes  is_diplomatic_play_committed_participant = yes  in_default = yes } }
			multiply = 0
		}
	}
}

				AND = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_yalu_river_family  ROOT ?= { OR = { this = global_var:pmr_dam_yalu_river_family  top_overlord ?= { this = global_var:pmr_dam_yalu_river_family } } } }
			} }
		NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_yalu_river_months }
		NOT = { p:x47D537.state ?= { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_small_dear  level_after_queued_constructions >= 2 } } }
		p:x47D537 ?= {
			state ?= {
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						this = ROOT
						any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
						any_scope_treaty = { binds = ROOT  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = ROOT } }
						any_overlord_or_above = { any_scope_treaty = { binds = ROOT  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = ROOT } } }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_bur_tt_900
			pmr_dam_bur_headroom > 900
		}
		hidden_trigger = {
			OR = { is_player = yes  NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_took_survey } }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_yalu_river_block_tt
			NOT = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_yalu_river_block }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_yalu_river_queued_tt
			NOT = { p:x47D537.state ?= { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_small_dear
				OR = { AND = { level < 1  level_after_queued_constructions >= 1 }
				AND = { level < 2  level_after_queued_constructions >= 2 }
			} } } }
		}
	}

	when_taken = {
		pmr_dam_yalu_river_begin_survey = yes
		set_variable = { name = pmr_dam_took_survey  days = 30 }
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { pmr_dam_bur_headroom > 900 }
			add = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { is_at_war = yes  is_diplomatic_play_committed_participant = yes  in_default = yes } }
			multiply = 0
		}
	}
}

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_survey_running_tt
			has_variable = pmr_dam_alcantara_gorge_months
		}
	}
	when_taken = {
		remove_variable = pmr_dam_alcantara_gorge_months
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|survey_stop|alcantara_gorge|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}
	ai_chance = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { in_default = yes }
			add = 50
		}
	}
}

pmr_dam_aura_nordland_survey_decision = {
	is_shown = {
		has_technology_researched = electrical_generation
		NOT = { OR = {
				ROOT ?= { has_variable = pmr_dam_aura_nordland_surveyed }
				AND = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_aura_nordland_family  ROOT ?= { OR = { this = global_var:pmr_dam_aura_nordland_family  top_overlord ?= { this = global_var:pmr_dam_aura_nordland_family } } } }
			} }
		NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_aura_nordland_months }
		NOT = { p:x042C26.state ?= { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_small_cheap  level_after_queued_constructions >= 2 } } }
		p:x042C26 ?= {
			state ?= {
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						this = ROOT
						any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
						any_scope_treaty = { binds = ROOT  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = ROOT } }
						any_overlord_or_above = { any_scope_treaty = { binds = ROOT  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = ROOT } } }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_bur_tt_800
			pmr_dam_bur_headroom > 800
		}
		hidden_trigger = {
			OR = { is_player = yes  NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_took_survey } }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_aura_nordland_block_tt
			NOT = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_aura_nordland_block }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_aura_nordland_queued_tt
			NOT = { p:x042C26.state ?= { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_small_cheap
				OR = { AND = { level < 1  level_after_queued_constructions >= 1 }
				AND = { level < 2  level_after_queued_constructions >= 2 }
			} } } }
		}
	}

	when_taken = {
		pmr_dam_aura_nordland_begin_survey = yes
		set_variable = { name = pmr_dam_took_survey  days = 30 }
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { pmr_dam_bur_headroom > 800 }
			add = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { is_at_war = yes  is_diplomatic_play_committed_participant = yes  in_default = yes } }
			multiply = 0
		}
	}
}

pmr_dam_aura_nordland_stop_survey_decision = {
	is_shown = { has_variable = pmr_dam_aura_nordland_months }
	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {

			NOT = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_koyna_western_ghats_block }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_koyna_western_ghats_queued_tt
			NOT = { p:x33E560.state ?= { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_small_cheap
				OR = { AND = { level < 1  level_after_queued_constructions >= 1 }
			} } } }
		}
	}

	when_taken = {
		pmr_dam_koyna_western_ghats_begin_survey = yes
		set_variable = { name = pmr_dam_took_survey  days = 30 }
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { pmr_dam_bur_headroom > 650 }
			add = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { is_at_war = yes  is_diplomatic_play_committed_participant = yes  in_default = yes } }
			multiply = 0
		}
	}
}

pmr_dam_tone_river_survey_decision = {
	is_shown = {
		has_technology_researched = electrical_generation
		NOT = { OR = {
				ROOT ?= { has_variable = pmr_dam_tone_river_surveyed }
				AND = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_tone_river_family  ROOT ?= { OR = { this = global_var:pmr_dam_tone_river_family  top_overlord ?= { this = global_var:pmr_dam_tone_river_family } } } }
			} }
		NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_tone_river_months }
		NOT = { p:x7090C0.state ?= { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_small_cheap  level_after_queued_constructions >= 1 } } }
		p:x7090C0 ?= {
			state ?= {
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						this = ROOT
						any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
						any_scope_treaty = { binds = ROOT  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = ROOT } }
						any_overlord_or_above = { any_scope_treaty = { binds = ROOT  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = ROOT } } }
					}
				}
			}
		}

		}

			OR = { is_player = yes  NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_took_survey } }

			NOT = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_tone_river_block }

			add = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { is_at_war = yes  is_diplomatic_play_committed_participant = yes  in_default = yes } }
			multiply = 0
		}
	}

						any_scope_treaty = { binds = ROOT  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = ROOT } }
						any_overlord_or_above = { any_scope_treaty = { binds = ROOT  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = ROOT } } }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_bur_tt_650
			pmr_dam_bur_headroom > 650
		}
		hidden_trigger = {
			OR = { is_player = yes  NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_took_survey } }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_travancore_highlands_block_tt
			NOT = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_travancore_highlands_block }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_travancore_highlands_queued_tt
			NOT = { p:xA11A79.state ?= { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_small_cheap
				OR = { AND = { level < 1  level_after_queued_constructions >= 1 }
			} } } }
		}
	}

	when_taken = {
		pmr_dam_travancore_highlands_begin_survey = yes
		set_variable = { name = pmr_dam_took_survey  days = 30 }
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { pmr_dam_bur_headroom > 650 }
			add = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { is_at_war = yes  is_diplomatic_play_committed_participant = yes  in_default = yes } }
			multiply = 0
		}
	}
}

		NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_zhiguli_volga_months }
		NOT = { p:x795854.state ?= { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_small_dear  level_after_queued_constructions >= 1 } } }
		p:x795854 ?= {
			state ?= {
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						this = ROOT
						any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
						any_scope_treaty = { binds = ROOT  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = ROOT } }
						any_overlord_or_above = { any_scope_treaty = { binds = ROOT  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = ROOT } } }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_bur_tt_750
			pmr_dam_bur_headroom > 750
		}
		hidden_trigger = {
			OR = { is_player = yes  NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_took_survey } }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_zhiguli_volga_block_tt
			NOT = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_zhiguli_volga_block }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_zhiguli_volga_queued_tt
			NOT = { p:x795854.state ?= { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_small_dear
				OR = { AND = { level < 1  level_after_queued_constructions >= 1 }
			} } } }
		}
	}

	when_taken = {
		pmr_dam_zhiguli_volga_begin_survey = yes
		set_variable = { name = pmr_dam_took_survey  days = 30 }
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { pmr_dam_bur_headroom > 750 }
			add = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { is_at_war = yes  is_diplomatic_play_committed_participant = yes  in_default = yes } }
			multiply = 0
		}
	}
}

		}
	}
}

		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|survey_stop|mequinenza_aragon_pyrenees|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}
	ai_chance = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { in_default = yes }
			add = 50
		}
	}
}

pmr_dam_asahan_toba_survey_decision = {
	is_shown = {
		has_technology_researched = electrical_generation
		NOT = { OR = {
				ROOT ?= { has_variable = pmr_dam_asahan_toba_surveyed }
				AND = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_asahan_toba_family  ROOT ?= { OR = { this = global_var:pmr_dam_asahan_toba_family  top_overlord ?= { this = global_var:pmr_dam_asahan_toba_family } } } }
			} }
		NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_asahan_toba_months }
		NOT = { p:x4F7793.state ?= { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_small_cheap  level_after_queued_constructions >= 1 } } }
		p:x4F7793 ?= {
			state ?= {
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						this = ROOT
						any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
						any_scope_treaty = { binds = ROOT  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = ROOT } }
						any_overlord_or_above = { any_scope_treaty = { binds = ROOT  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = ROOT } } }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_bur_tt_650
			pmr_dam_bur_headroom > 650
		}
		hidden_trigger = {
			OR = { is_player = yes  NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_took_survey } }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_asahan_toba_block_tt
			NOT = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_asahan_toba_block }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_asahan_toba_queued_tt
			NOT = { p:x4F7793.state ?= { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_small_cheap
				OR = { AND = { level < 1  level_after_queued_constructions >= 1 }
			} } } }
		}
	}

	when_taken = {
		pmr_dam_asahan_toba_begin_survey = yes
		set_variable = { name = pmr_dam_took_survey  days = 30 }
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { pmr_dam_bur_headroom > 650 }
			add = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { is_at_war = yes  is_diplomatic_play_committed_participant = yes  in_default = yes } }
			multiply = 0
		}
	}
}

pmr_dam_asahan_toba_stop_survey_decision = {
	is_shown = { has_variable = pmr_dam_asahan_toba_months }

		custom_tooltip = {

pmr_dam_hells_canyon_survey_decision = {
	is_shown = {
		has_technology_researched = steam_turbine
		NOT = { OR = {
				ROOT ?= { has_variable = pmr_dam_hells_canyon_surveyed }
				AND = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_hells_canyon_family  ROOT ?= { OR = { this = global_var:pmr_dam_hells_canyon_family  top_overlord ?= { this = global_var:pmr_dam_hells_canyon_family } } } }
			} }
		NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_hells_canyon_months }
		NOT = { p:xCE1B4B.state ?= { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_small_dear  level_after_queued_constructions >= 1 } } }
		p:xCE1B4B ?= {
			state ?= {
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						this = ROOT
						any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
						any_scope_treaty = { binds = ROOT  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = ROOT } }
						any_overlord_or_above = { any_scope_treaty = { binds = ROOT  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = ROOT } } }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_bur_tt_750
			pmr_dam_bur_headroom > 750
		}
		hidden_trigger = {
			OR = { is_player = yes  NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_took_survey } }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_hells_canyon_block_tt
			NOT = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_hells_canyon_block }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_hells_canyon_queued_tt
			NOT = { p:xCE1B4B.state ?= { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_small_dear
				OR = { AND = { level < 1  level_after_queued_constructions >= 1 }
			} } } }
		}
	}

	when_taken = {
		pmr_dam_hells_canyon_begin_survey = yes
		set_variable = { name = pmr_dam_took_survey  days = 30 }
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { pmr_dam_bur_headroom > 750 }
			add = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { is_at_war = yes  is_diplomatic_play_committed_participant = yes  in_default = yes } }
			multiply = 0
		}
	}
}

		pmr_dam_bhutan_duars_begin_survey = yes
		set_variable = { name = pmr_dam_took_survey  days = 30 }
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { pmr_dam_bur_headroom > 650 }
			add = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { is_at_war = yes  is_diplomatic_play_committed_participant = yes  in_default = yes } }
			multiply = 0
		}
	}
}

			pmr_dam_bur_headroom > 650
		}
		hidden_trigger = {
			OR = { is_player = yes  NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_took_survey } }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_galloway_tummel_block_tt
			NOT = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_galloway_tummel_block }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_galloway_tummel_queued_tt
			NOT = { p:x206080.state ?= { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_small_cheap
				OR = { AND = { level < 1  level_after_queued_constructions >= 1 }
			} } } }
		}
	}

	when_taken = {
		pmr_dam_galloway_tummel_begin_survey = yes
		set_variable = { name = pmr_dam_took_survey  days = 30 }
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { pmr_dam_bur_headroom > 650 }
			add = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { is_at_war = yes  is_diplomatic_play_committed_participant = yes  in_default = yes } }
			multiply = 0
		}
	}
}

						any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
						any_scope_treaty = { binds = ROOT  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = ROOT } }
						any_overlord_or_above = { any_scope_treaty = { binds = ROOT  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = ROOT } } }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_bur_tt_750
			pmr_dam_bur_headroom > 750
		}
		hidden_trigger = {
			OR = { is_player = yes  NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_took_survey } }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_onega_vyg_block_tt
			NOT = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_onega_vyg_block }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_onega_vyg_queued_tt
			NOT = { p:xA857F6.state ?= { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_small_dear
				OR = { AND = { level < 1  level_after_queued_constructions >= 1 }
			} } } }
		}
	}

	when_taken = {
		pmr_dam_onega_vyg_begin_survey = yes
		set_variable = { name = pmr_dam_took_survey  days = 30 }
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { pmr_dam_bur_headroom > 750 }
			add = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { is_at_war = yes  is_diplomatic_play_committed_participant = yes  in_default = yes } }
			multiply = 0
		}
	}
}

				AND = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_volkhov_svir_family  ROOT ?= { OR = { this = global_var:pmr_dam_volkhov_svir_family  top_overlord ?= { this = global_var:pmr_dam_volkhov_svir_family } } } }
			} }
		NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_volkhov_svir_months }
		NOT = { p:xF4E44C.state ?= { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_small_dear  level_after_queued_constructions >= 1 } } }
		p:xF4E44C ?= {
			state ?= {
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						this = ROOT
						any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
						any_scope_treaty = { binds = ROOT  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = ROOT } }
						any_overlord_or_above = { any_scope_treaty = { binds = ROOT  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = ROOT } } }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_bur_tt_750
			pmr_dam_bur_headroom > 750
		}
		hidden_trigger = {
			OR = { is_player = yes  NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_took_survey } }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_volkhov_svir_block_tt
			NOT = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_volkhov_svir_block }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_volkhov_svir_queued_tt
			NOT = { p:xF4E44C.state ?= { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_small_dear
				OR = { AND = { level < 1  level_after_queued_constructions >= 1 }
			} } } }
		}
	}

	when_taken = {
		pmr_dam_volkhov_svir_begin_survey = yes
		set_variable = { name = pmr_dam_took_survey  days = 30 }
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { pmr_dam_bur_headroom > 750 }
			add = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { is_at_war = yes  is_diplomatic_play_committed_participant = yes  in_default = yes } }
			multiply = 0
		}
	}
}

		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|survey_stop|guatape_falls|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}
	ai_chance = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { in_default = yes }
			add = 50
		}
	}
}

pmr_dam_pyramid_canyon_survey_decision = {
	is_shown = {
		has_technology_researched = steam_turbine
		NOT = { OR = {
				ROOT ?= { has_variable = pmr_dam_pyramid_canyon_surveyed }
				AND = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_pyramid_canyon_family  ROOT ?= { OR = { this = global_var:pmr_dam_pyramid_canyon_family  top_overlord ?= { this = global_var:pmr_dam_pyramid_canyon_family } } } }
			} }
		NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_pyramid_canyon_months }
		NOT = { p:xF31ACC.state ?= { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_small_dear  level_after_queued_constructions >= 1 } } }
		p:xF31ACC ?= {
			state ?= {
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						this = ROOT
						any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
						any_scope_treaty = { binds = ROOT  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = ROOT } }
						any_overlord_or_above = { any_scope_treaty = { binds = ROOT  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = ROOT } } }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_bur_tt_750
			pmr_dam_bur_headroom > 750
		}
		hidden_trigger = {
			OR = { is_player = yes  NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_took_survey } }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_pyramid_canyon_block_tt
			NOT = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_pyramid_canyon_block }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_pyramid_canyon_queued_tt
			NOT = { p:xF31ACC.state ?= { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_small_dear
				OR = { AND = { level < 1  level_after_queued_constructions >= 1 }
			} } } }
		}
	}

	when_taken = {
		pmr_dam_pyramid_canyon_begin_survey = yes
		set_variable = { name = pmr_dam_took_survey  days = 30 }
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { pmr_dam_bur_headroom > 750 }
			add = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { is_at_war = yes  is_diplomatic_play_committed_participant = yes  in_default = yes } }
			multiply = 0
		}
	}
}

	is_shown = { has_variable = pmr_dam_pyramid_canyon_months }

	is_shown = { has_variable = pmr_dam_nilgiri_hills_months }

			text = pmr_dam_survey_running_tt
			has_variable = pmr_dam_nilgiri_hills_months
		}

		remove_variable = pmr_dam_nilgiri_hills_months
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|survey_stop|nilgiri_hills|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}
	ai_chance = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { in_default = yes }
			add = 50
		}
	}
}

pmr_dam_bistritza_gorge_survey_decision = {
	is_shown = {
		has_technology_researched = electrical_generation
		NOT = { OR = {
				ROOT ?= { has_variable = pmr_dam_bistritza_gorge_surveyed }
				AND = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_bistritza_gorge_family  ROOT ?= { OR = { this = global_var:pmr_dam_bistritza_gorge_family  top_overlord ?= { this = global_var:pmr_dam_bistritza_gorge_family } } } }
			} }
		NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_bistritza_gorge_months }
		NOT = { p:xFF2F40.state ?= { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_small_cheap  level_after_queued_constructions >= 1 } } }
		p:xFF2F40 ?= {
			state ?= {
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						this = ROOT
						any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
						any_scope_treaty = { binds = ROOT  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = ROOT } }
						any_overlord_or_above = { any_scope_treaty = { binds = ROOT  any_scope_article = { has_type = foreign_investment_rights  target_country = ROOT } } }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_bur_tt_650
			pmr_dam_bur_headroom > 650
		}
		hidden_trigger = {
			OR = { is_player = yes  NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_took_survey } }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_bistritza_gorge_block_tt
			NOT = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_bistritza_gorge_block }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_bistritza_gorge_queued_tt
			NOT = { p:xFF2F40.state ?= { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_small_cheap
				OR = { AND = { level < 1  level_after_queued_constructions >= 1 }
			} } } }
		}
	}

	when_taken = {
		pmr_dam_bistritza_gorge_begin_survey = yes
		set_variable = { name = pmr_dam_took_survey  days = 30 }
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { pmr_dam_bur_headroom > 650 }
			add = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { is_at_war = yes  is_diplomatic_play_committed_participant = yes  in_default = yes } }
			multiply = 0
		}
	}
}

			NOT = { p:x9BAA9B.state ?= { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_small_dear
				OR = { AND = { level < 1  level_after_queued_constructions >= 1 }
			} } } }
		}
	}

	when_taken = {
		pmr_dam_sennar_blue_nile_begin_survey = yes
		set_variable = { name = pmr_dam_took_survey  days = 30 }
	}

	ai_chance = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { pmr_dam_bur_headroom > 750 }
			add = 10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { is_at_war = yes  is_diplomatic_play_committed_participant = yes  in_default = yes } }
			multiply = 0
		}
	}
}

pmr_dam_sennar_blue_nile_stop_survey_decision = {
	is_shown = { has_variable = pmr_dam_sennar_blue_nile_months }
	possible = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pmr_dam_survey_running_tt
			has_variable = pmr_dam_sennar_blue_nile_months
		}
	}
	when_taken = {
		remove_variable = pmr_dam_sennar_blue_nile_months
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|survey_stop|sennar_blue_nile|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}
	ai_chance = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { in_default = yes }
			add = 50
		}
	}
}
